info.description:
RDDMS M27 preship CI/CD collection. Uses environment variables for auth and partition.

Environment variables required:
- Token_Fetch_URL: token endpoint
- CLIENT_ID
- CLIENT_SECRET (or empty for public clients)
- Scope
- grant_type: client_credentials or refresh_token
- refresh_token (if grant_type=refresh_token)
- data-partition-id
- RDDMS_URL: e.g. https://host/api/reservoir-ddms/v2
- domain: entitlements domain (e.g. .group or .contoso.com)
- defaultLegalTag: (optional, auto-created if missing)

request.description:
Optional. Uploads an EPC (+ optional H5) and, when `autoIngest` is set, ingests the RESQML manifest into OSDU.

**File dependency (why this is not run by default in CI):** set the collection/environment variables `epc_file_path` and `h5_file_path` to local file paths (e.g. `data/drogon201/drogon.epc` and `drogon.h5`) before running. Without a valid file, the server returns 400/415 and the test tolerates it.

**Query params:** `autoIngest` = false|true|records|workflow; `validate` = false|true|strict.

item.description: Full RESQML→OSDU round-trip. Reuses the transaction-committed data seeded in section 2 (Setup): build a manifest (M1), ingest it through the Osdu_ingest Airflow DAG (M2), poll the workflow run to completion (M3), verify the records are retrievable/indexed (M4), then delete them from Storage (M5). The OSDU steps auto-skip when the platform hosts (WORKFLOW_URL / SEARCH_HOST / STORAGE_HOST) are not configured, so the section still runs manifest-only against a plain RDDMS environment.

item.description: Self-seeds Drogon data by uploading data/drogon/drogon201.epc over REST (epc-only; the 218MB H5 is omitted) then validates. Removes the dependency on the pre-seeded maap/drogon201b. /epc/upload + /validate are limited-deployment (404 on current preship) so tests tolerate 404 and light up after the preship etpclient->M27 upgrade.
